exposure: maternal intrapartum group B Streptococcus antibiotic prophylaxis
Maternal intrapartum group B Streptococcus (GBS) antibiotic prophylaxis
finding: Intrapartum GBS prophylaxis was not associated with increased incidence of asthma, eczema, food allergy, or allergic rhinitis within the first 5 years of life.
mod_finding: Intrapartum GBS prophylaxis was not associated with subsequent diagnosis of asthma, eczema, food allergy, or allergic rhinitis in the first 5 years of age regardless of delivery mode.
